name: nested-inheritance
note: text-align inherits: a directly-centered block, a wrapping parent with text-align:right whose block child inherits the right alignment, and a grandchild that overrides back to left. Each block aligns its own lines independently; computed values match Chrome per element.

harvest.html:
outer text is centered and wraps onto several lines inside its own box
this nested block inherits the right alignment from its parent
this innermost block overrides the inherited alignment back to left
